description: The plot illustrates the performance of two different validating methods, SmoE and SimSMoE, over a series of training steps. The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps," is on a linear scale and ranges from 0 to 50,000 steps, with each tick representing 10,000 steps. The y-axis, labeled "BPC," is also on a linear scale and ranges from 1.2 to 2.2, with each tick representing an increment of 0.2. The SmoE method is represented by a black line with 'x' markers, while the SimSMoE method is represented by a magenta line with no markers. Both lines start at a high BPC value of approximately 2.2 at 0 training steps and show a sharp decline to a BPC value of around 1.2 by 10,000 training steps. After this initial drop, both lines exhibit a relatively flat trend, maintaining a BPC value close to 1.2 for the remainder of the training steps, with only minor fluctuations.
